name: google-ads-management
description: Ongoing, cadence-based Google Ads management as done-with-you advisors — dual input (read-only Google Ads MCP or a user CSV export), fronted by an interactive task menu with a conversational fallback: select a task or ask to 'manage Google Ads' to open the `google-ads` hub, which lists every task and routes to it. A shared foundation (account selection, GAQL cookbook, 2026 benchmarks, dual-input + advisor output contract) plus account health & red flags, budget pacing, bidding strategy, keywords/search terms, Quality Score forensics, audience targeting, conversions & tracking, performance reporting, competitive analysis, PMax campaigns, PMax listing groups, and product performance. Diagnoses account data against thresholds behind a transcription firewall, then leads a prioritized recommendation loop and offers ready-to-apply Google Ads Editor CSVs — emitting the md + interactive-HTML + tunable-xlsx bundle (or a reduced md + xlsx bundle for account health & audience targeting), with Node<->Python kernel parity across every tunable skill.

interface.shortDescription: Manage Google Ads with guided analysis and recommendations.
interface.longDescription: Use an interactive task menu or conversational requests to route account health, pacing, bidding, search terms, Quality Score, audiences, conversion tracking, reporting, competitive analysis, PMax, and product-performance work.
defaultPrompt: Manage this Google Ads account and show me the task menu.
Diagnose account health and prioritize next actions.
Review budget pacing and bidding from this export.
